- [USER] The user is asking for tips on creating a bedtime routine to improve sleep quality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for creating a bedtime routine include:
  1. Establish a consistent sleep schedule.
  2. Gradually wind down 30-60 minutes before bedtime with relaxing activities.
  3. Create a sleep-conducive environment (cool, dark, quiet).
  4. Disconnect from screens at least an hour before bedtime.
  5. Limit stimulating activities before bed.
  6. Get ready for bed with a calming pre-sleep routine.
  7. Make it a ritual with consistent activities.
  8. Be consistent even on weekends.
  9. Adjust and adapt the routine as needed.
  10. Prioritize sleep as essential for health and well-being.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It may take time for the body to adjust to a new bedtime routine; patience is key.
